findings.description: Direct inspection of current V205 renders shows both front thighs projecting beyond the overskirt during crouch and sit; the lilac front hem and panels fold back behind the knees despite widening the thigh-follow band. Outer-skirt coverage remains unusable in both required poses.
Front, three-quarter, neutral and side views still show dense angular crushed creases across the front overskirt; the broader follow band did not address the pleat surface response.
Prone render still tents/bunches the skirt, side silhouettes retain a trailing hem step, and gray gaps remain at sleeve roots/armholes including raised-arm view.

nextAction: Keep V205 rejected. Replace the front-lap pose response rather than widening the same skinning ramp: the direct crouch/sit images still expose both thighs and fold the overskirt behind the knees. Redesign the front-lap panels for seated/crouched drape while maintaining waist and side seams; independently reshape front pleat relief into broad channels and correct prone drape, side hem continuity, and sleeve-root coverage. Rebuild and directly inspect all five views and six poses; fit, rig/weight, Shape Key, Unity/VRChat, package, and release gates remain unverified.
